abort.confirmation_failed: The remote could not be confirmed.

user.description: Starts listening for SONOFF eWeLink-Remote BLE devices. Unknown remotes appear as discovered devices and are added only after physical confirmation.

confirm.title: Add {name}

progress.wait_for_button: Press any button on {name} to confirm this remote.
